title: Feature Request: add xDrip+ Sync Follower to SourceWizard on first page
body:
It is not possible to select `xDrip+ Sync Follower` in data source wizard. It is not on first page and it is not nested in other.

I suggest to add it to the fist wizard page, under `Others`.

Selecting this item should set xDrip hardware source to `xDrip+ Sync Follower` and start `ActivityDisplayQrcodeBinding`.

comments.body:
@k2s Would you please update this?
Has it been resolved with more recent releases?

We are asking people to use xDrip as is if they can.
We are asking people to use work-arounds instead of asking for nice-to-have features.
If you like to reopen this, you can.  But, I suggest you provide a good reason why this is necessary.
xDrip Sync is now one of the options in Source Wizard as of the 2025.06.20 release.
